content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I'm new to this forum, so my question might already be answered elsewhere. I need help with an older machine equipped with a [product_name] [article_no] 24V DC (12 inputs, 8 relay outputs), which is currently operational. I'm looking to make some upgrades and need to copy the program to my computer. I have [product_name] [version_no] installed along with RS232 and USB cables. From what I've gathered, I need to stop the program on the [product_name] before copying. My issue is that on my TD display, only two menu options appear: Set Param and Set Clock. During normal operation, the TD shows input status at the top, date in the middle, and output status at the bottom. To access Set Param and Set Clock, I press Esc and OK together, but no other key combinations seem to work, and I can't access additional menus. Does anyone know why this happens? I can't connect from my PC. One suggestion is that the [product_name] should be in STOP mode, or perhaps the communication port is faulty. My computer connects fine with other [version_no] models. Any help would be appreciated!

Hello [user_name], Try this key combination: Press Right, Left, and OK together. Then choose PC/Card, followed by PC <-> [product_name]. This should allow you to transfer the program. Best regards, [user_name]
Yes! That's perfect. The program stopped as needed, and using the START command, it runs properly again. Thanks for your help—the issue is resolved and the thread can be closed.

analysis.insight_summary: A user struggled to access necessary menu options on an older [product_name] device to stop its program and transfer it to a PC using [product_name] software. The limited display interface hampered progress until another user shared the correct key combination, enabling successful program transfer and restart.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects intuitive menu navigation on the [product_name]'s TD display for easily accessing stop mode and performing program transfers to a PC using [product_name] software, similar to what is available on newer models.
